issues.description: Method name mismatch for the SealSaloon delivery API: the problem statement UML (and descriptive text) requires a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) on class SealSaloon. The provided solution implements a static method with the same parameters but named receiveDelivery(String, int, int). The template's Main.java (commented example) also calls acceptSupplyDelivery(...). This naming divergence between the specification/problem text, the example in Main, and the reference implementation will confuse students about which method to implement and may cause tests or example code that call acceptSupplyDelivery to fail or appear inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API name consistent across all artifacts. Either rename the solution's receiveDelivery(...) method to acceptSupplyDelivery(...) (keeping it static with the same parameters and behavior) or update the problem statement, UML diagram, and template Main.java example to refer to receiveDelivery(...). Ensure tests and all example code use the same chosen name so students implement and call the expected method unambiguously.
